answer: Make every agent lock a refundable stake before it can earn, like a cedar putting down deep roots: one identity, one deposit, one reputation. A Sybil attacker must fund each fake identity separately, so the cost of a thousand sockpuppets is a thousand stakes, while an honest agent pays once. Slashing burns the deposit of any identity caught cheating, so the lagoon of cheap fakes drains into an umber ledger of losses instead of profit.
